messages:
Priya: Hey team, quick onboarding q: I cant find the Template Library in Notion and I dont have edit rights. Where should I store ramp notes and how do I request template edit access?
Ben: Welcome! Template Library lives at Docs Home > Library > Templates (https://redwood.notion.so/... ). For edit access you can run ` /doc-access request <page-url>` or email docs-admin@redwood.com. If the page is in a restricted space make sure your SSO group `redwood-employees` is provisioned.
docs-bot: Automations: Use `/doc-access request <link>` -> choose role (viewer|editor). Or open page -> Share -> Request edit -> send to docs-admin. Typical SLA: 1 business day.
Taylor: Naming conventions quick guide: use `team-slug / doc-type / short-title` e.g. `eng-runtime / runbook / gpu-handoffs`. Use kebab-case, add tags at top like `#runbook #oncall`. Include header metadata: Owner, Team, Tags, Last updated.
Priya: A few templates show as "Team Template - Locked". How do I unlock those to make changes?
Ben: Locked templates can only be edited by the Page Owner or assigned doc-editors. Check the page header for Owner. If Owner exists, DM them a short ask. If no owner, post in #devex-docs with the link and justification and request an unlock.
people-ops: Note for contractors/vendors: access to restricted Team spaces requires completed vendor onboarding + signed DPA. Please email security@redwood.com and people-ops@redwood.com to get that started.
Priya: If I duplicate a template into my Private workspace, will reviewers see my changes? I want to keep a link to the original.
Taylor: Duplicate into Private -> add a small line at top `Derived from: <template link>` and append a 1-line changelog at the bottom. If you intend to contribute upstream, open a "Template update" PR via the governance page (Docs Home > Governance > Template updates).
Ben: Additional rule: when you change shared templates add the tag `#template-change` in the page so the docs team can search and review diffs.
Priya: Thanks! I just ran `/doc-access` and requested editor for the ramp template. I also created `Private/Onboarding/Priya-ramp` for personal notes.
docs-bot: If you still don't have access after 24h run `/doc-help` or email docs-admin@redwood.com. Thread closed unless you reply.
